summary: The R2 committed tree and all frozen boundaries pass independent scope checks. R1 C06/C07/C08/C09 were independently reexecuted and their original failures close in the tested virtual flows. Transport remains blocked by a further export boundary: root child.exitCode and child.signalCode are copied into uploaded case JSON without value validation. Synthetic canaries in either property reach artifacts; an unknown signal can additionally coexist with diagnosticCompleted=true. This is an artifact-boundary finding, not evidence that native Node/Windows can produce those values or that any real secret leaked.

Independently authored VM controls run actual source functions extracted from exact Git source. Generator claims were not used as acceptance evidence.

findings.observedLimits: All files/processes/streams for C11 are virtual. The test proves missing export validation, not actual native reachability of arbitrary signal/exit properties, actual host secret access, or actual leakage. Native Node/Windows behavior is unexecuted and unknown.

retainedControlHistory.detail: Initial draft findings are preserved. C05 was a test expectation error: append failure happens during initial guard-preload before the later counter failure, so the first failure reason is GUARD_LOG_IO_OR_LIMIT; health still fails closed. C07 was a test regex error matching the legitimate allowlisted boolean key rawContentFound rather than a leaked rawContent key. Both test defects were corrected without changing the CLI. C11 remains independently confirmed. Archived control source hashes match their original outputs.

First frozen run retains C11 failure as an assertion; the other eleven controls pass. Final run expands only C11 into independent root signal/exit/pid/error/close metadata cases and records the observed artifact effects directly.
Authoritative final run: 12 controls completed, 11 pass, C11 fails, no control-execution failure, exact CLI source unchanged throughout.
